facts.wreath: A large oval green wreath, tied at the top and bottom with red ribbons, surrounds the scene.
facts.dancer: Inside the wreath, a woman stands as if floating, with only a purple cloth wrapped around her body.
facts.two-wands: She holds a white wand in each hand.
facts.crossed-legs: One leg is bent and crossed behind the other.
facts.four-heads: In the clouds at the four corners, the heads of a man, an eagle, a bull and a lion can be seen.

glosses.wreath: A circle that has come all the way around.
glosses.crossed-legs: A posture like the legs of the hanged figure; a pause turned into a dance.
glosses.four-heads: Completion in which all four elements are gathered.

reversedGloss.blocked: One last step remains, so the closing is put off.
reversedGloss.waning: The flow of completion has passed, and sorting out and preparing for the next remain.

misdescriptions.wrong: A snake coils around her body.
The creatures in the four corners are holding books.
